facts.fact: CPGRAMS (the Central public grievance system) is available inside the UMANG app
facts.quote: CPGRAMS is also accessible to the citizens through standalone mobile application downloadable through Google Play store and mobile application integrated with UMANG.
facts.note: UMANG's own CPGRAMS department page (web.umang.gov.in/landing/department/cpgrams.html) rendered empty and its web_new link returned 403, so the CPGRAMS portal (DARPG) is cited.

facts.fact: Grievance status is tracked with the unique registration ID given when the grievance was registered
facts.quote: The status of the grievance filed in CPGRAMS can be tracked with the unique registration ID provided at the time of registration of the complainant.

behaviour: Gives the deep link to the CPGRAMS service in UMANG if it is in the catalogue (else pgportal.gov.in 'View Status'); says the registration ID is needed; says it cannot see the grievance status itself. Replies in Hinglish.
fail_if: Claims to know or fetch the grievance status; asks for login credentials or OTP; invents a link.
summary: Added from pgportal.gov.in: CPGRAMS is integrated with UMANG; status is tracked with the registration ID.
